issue: Halls of Valor Odyn surrender on the threshold-crossing hit
status: production/native regression passed; client verification pending
observed_before_repair: Native pre-scaling DamageTaken tested only existing HealthBelowPct81. A fresh lethal hit set health80% and damage0 but left the encounter IN_PROGRESS and emitted no95676 quest credit until another hit. The regression extracts that actual old handler from the pinned commit and reproduces it.
Raw damage could exceed unscaled template health while the normalized hit remained small for the attacker-relative pool. The old raw-health cap could therefore force80% early.
implementation: Use the existing DamageTakenAfterScaling virtual hook; Unit::DealDamage invokes it after final damage normalization and before its lethal comparison. Compare final damage against GetHealth(attacker)/GetMaxHealth(attacker), preserving the existing strict below81% threshold. Both ordinary threshold-crossing and fresh scaled lethal hits surrender immediately.

Once surrender begins, set damage0 and encounterComplete before callbacks; retain80% displayed health, native_JustDied encounter transition, dungeon1809 achievement,200988 removal, map-wide95676 player credit, faction/flags/combat/home cleanup,5000ms despawn and optional208534 achievement. Repeated incoming hits are suppressed without repeating completion or credit. Zero damage and dormant/completed states cannot start a completion; a ready first spell uses the ordinary combat-entry callback.

Spell::DoAllEffectOnTarget calls DealSpellDamage before CombatStart. If the unlocked intro is finished, faction16 is attackable, Skovald is DONE and Odyn is not DONE, a first spell can initialize ordinary combat through SetInCombatWith before evaluating surrender. Protected/dormant/locked states do not bootstrap. The extracted native EnterCombat body preserves achievement initialization and event scheduling.
Core damage/combat dispatch, instance encounter/loot code and spell handlers are unchanged. The separate Aegis claim repair has its own migration/audit.
